title: Biobased epoxy resins from itaconic anhydride functionalized lignin: insights and comparison with succinic analogues
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,1615-1632
DOI: 10.1039/D6SU00045B, Paper
Open Access

Celeste Libretti, Gianluca Giuseppe Rizzo, Sophia Abou El Mirate, Mats Johansson, Michael A. R. Meier
Lignin is functionalized with biobased cyclic anhydrides to yield reactive macromonomers, which are subsequently used as crosslinkers to obtain fully biobased and degradable epoxy thermosets.
